protocol: Base system prompt, non-thinking, greedy decoding, at most 200 new tokens. 95% cluster-bootstrap intervals (2,000 resamples over problem groups).
api_protocol: Proprietary models: same system prompt and response format through provider APIs, tool records sent as native tool calls, default reasoning, 90 sampled problem groups of the held-out split plus natural history. Not a like-for-like comparison with the open track.

models.label: Conviction-RL (ours)
models.note: Seed 1. A second seed (E6) reaches 0.642 test_structural final accuracy.

models.label: Conviction-v2 (ours)
models.lab: light SFT then GRPO on Qwen3-1.7B
models.note: 1,000-example SFT warm-start, then the same 200-step GRPO as Conviction-RL. Not yet released.

models.label: MobileLLM-Pro
models.note: Ships custom code for transformers 4.53; evaluated with transformers 4.56.2. Follows the JSON format strictly in about half of responses, which lowers its scores.

models.label: LFM3-1.7B
models.note: Mostly ignores the JSON-only instruction and reasons in free text (strict format 5%), often running past the 200-token limit; its scores mainly measure format compliance.

thinking.note: Thinking on (sampled, T=0.6, up to 4,096 tokens) minus thinking off (greedy), same 1,257 held-out episodes (90 problem groups), paired cluster bootstrap.
